setup.scope: This market covers virgin and refined olive oil (including extra-virgin, virgin, and blended/refined olive oil) destined for edible and cosmetic-grade use, valued at the point of first sale into consumption or export. It excludes table olives, olive pomace oil, olive-leaf extracts, and non-olive vegetable/seed oils, which are separately valued commodities. Olive oil used as an input to downstream products (e.g. canned fish, cosmetics, prepared foods) remains in scope only to the extent of the olive oil itself; the downstream finished product is never priced here, though its production volume is legitimate intermediate evidence for deriving the olive oil it requires. Production-side inputs such as olive groves, harvesting labour, and milling services are out of scope.

setup.scope: This market covers olive oil as a finished edible commodity — virgin and refined olive oil (including extra virgin, virgin, and blended/refined grades) sold in bulk, retail, foodservice, and food-processing channels for human consumption and related culinary use. It excludes non-olive vegetable oils (e.g., sunflower, rapeseed, HVO/renewable diesel feedstocks), olive-derived products valued as separate markets (olive pomace oil, olive leaf extract, table olives, and cosmetic/personal-care olive oil formulations), and the raw olive fruit itself. Downstream end-use demand — such as food processing, foodservice, or nutraceutical/cosmetic usage — is used only as an intermediate signal to derive how much olive oil that usage requires; it is never priced or valued as part of this market. Any usage with no defensible link to olive oil as an edible commodity (e.g., olive oil converted into biodiesel/HVO fuel) is out of scope.
